description: 1. Agent reads SKILL_DIR/SKILL.md to discover the exact CLI invocation for generate_blessing.py and the canonical parameter values. 2. Agent reads campaign/requests/batch_q1_2025.json and maps each request's English-language informal fields to the Chinese canonical values required by the script: 'elder'→'长辈', 'peer'→'平辈', 'junior'→'晚辈'; 'formal'→'正式', 'humorous'→'幽默', 'poetic-rhyming'→'押韵', 'literary'→'文艺', 'warm'→'温情'; length values 'short'/'medium'/'long' passed as-is. 3. Agent invokes python3 SKILL_DIR/scripts/generate_blessing.py with the five correct flag sets, capturing stdout for each. 4. Agent parses each output to extract all three emoji-labeled versions (🎁版本一, 🎊版本二, ✨版本三). 5. Agent writes blessings_report.json containing all five entries keyed by req_001–req_005, each holding the three blessing variants. The eval verifies correct parameter usage via a deterministic hash seed embedded in the script's output.
